description: Independent desktop processes; initialization includes file reads. Cold index includes archive SHA-256, CRC-checked inflation, index SHA-256, opening and cache writing. Warm index reads and verifies the uncompressed cache. OS page cache is not flushed. Each round alternates the legacy and index groups, keeping cold before warm within the index group. Repeated queries measure the engine, not the service result cache or Android UI.
tiePolicy: Match position in UTF-16, then score. Equal primary ranks may select different aliases because the new index has deterministic tie order.

buildInstructions.weeklySynchronization: Weekly synchronization commits updated source data. The next build regenerates the index ZIP and bootstrap from that source archive; generated assets are not committed.
buildInstructions.localSourceUpdates: Regenerate the derived assets after updating the source archive.
buildInstructions.measurementImpact: Generating the same index assets at build time instead of storing them in Git does not change the app-bundled bytes, asset hashes or recorded performance measurements.

execution: Dart 3.10.8 native AOT executable; four alternating rounds, twelve independent processes on the same Linux host

measurementNotes.aggregation: Median and observed minimum/maximum across four independent processes per mode; query summaries use the first call in each process.
measurementNotes.order: Odd rounds: legacy, index-cold, index-warm. Even rounds: index-cold, index-warm, legacy. Actual order is stored on every round.
